events.title: Covenantal Theology
events.description: How Scripture tells one unified story through God's promises, how those covenants shape our reading of the Bible, and why they matter for faith and daily life.

events.title: Just War Theory
events.description: When, if ever, is war morally justified? We'll explore the Christian tradition's criteria for just cause, legitimate authority, proportionality, protection of noncombatants, and the pursuit of peace.
